spec.description: This dashboard template visualizes key service health metrics such as traffic, error rate, latency, and CPU saturation. It provides both aggregated views and a detailed endpoint breakdown to help identify bottlenecks and monitor system reliability and capacity.
Quick bottleneck insight - Top endpoints by request volume, error rate, and average latency. Identify problematic routes at a glance.
spec.title: Endpoint breakdown
